title: stainless steel rolling pin
text: stainless steel rolling pin. Oh.  This is wonderful.  The only I will say is that when you wash it you will want to stand it up so that it drains.  Other than that it really did reduce the effort involved in rolling out pie crusts.  I love that it's stainless.  It does take a little getting used to - I've always had wooden pins.  But I think it would be hard to go back to those after using this one. Cleans up in a flash.. - just be sure to stand up to drain.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
